_comment: Values scripts/staging-secrets.py copies from production into staging's secrets. Everything else is staging's own.
settings: configuration, not credentials, so staging behaves like production.

shared: production credentials staging uses on purpose, for providers that allow only one app. Whoever breaks into staging can read these: keep the list short, and rotate them in production if a staging alert says someone got in (docs/staging.md).
The script refuses any key on its never-copy list (JWT_SECRET, Stripe, R2, the Farcaster mnemonic, bot tokens, billing and webhook secrets, analytics).
